title: 8/11 MLB auth flap: one blank HTTP 200 failed the contest-streak fetch and the DM wrongly advised a cookie re-capture
tier_reason: the alert misdiagnosed an external outage as dead cookies and advised an interactive re-capture on the real contest account (extra auth traffic on the account a ban would cost); the contest-streak refresh failed

contract.text: An outage-shaped MLB auth failure (transport error, 5xx, empty 200) is retried and reported as transient; only credential-shaped failures advise re-capturing cookies.
contract.source: 404358d; ARCHITECTURE.md 'Hardened 2026-08-11 (auth-flap incident)' (e5354bf); CLAUDE.md leaderboard/contest account-safety rules

mechanism.text: fetch_login_session made a single attempt, so one zero-length HTTP 200 from auth/login during MLB's flap failed the fetch-contest-streak cron
the cron's failure handling treated every login failure as credential-shaped, so the DM advised re-capturing cookies that were valid all day

mitigated.action: operator session refreshed the contest ledger on the box by hand

residual.text: During a transient auth outage check-pick-entered keeps its quiet skip (v3 design): no entry verification or DM until a later */15 run authenticates.
Backoff jitter was rejected (single low-volume client).

watchdog.trigger: fetch-contest-streak or check-pick-entered fails: the alert must carry the failure category (transient outage / rate-limited / credential) derived from the response shape, and contest-state age past its expected refresh is itself alerted
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next scheduled fetch succeeds and the contest state's source date advances; no credential advice was sent for an outage-shaped failure

evidence.what: 8/11: auth/login returned blank HTTP 200s (~1 in 3 for a stretch) and 503s; the single-shot login turned one blank 200 into a failed cron plus a DM advising cookie re-capture — cookies were valid all day
bounded auth retry, elapsed-aware cutoff, quiet skip kept for transient outages

evidence.locator: operator memory note (claude-shared bts_index, '2026-08-11 MLB auth/login flap'; not in the repo)
evidence.what: the 13:30 fetch-contest-streak cron failed once and DMed the wrong advice; an operator session refreshed the contest ledger at 13:46; auth/login answered 3/3 from the box around 15:25
0e4aaa8 installed 2026-08-10T02:00:22Z and not replaced until run 31532428453: the single-shot login was live on 8/11

notes: the DM was the incident's harmful output, so it is both the detection and the misdiagnosis; its exact time (13:30 per the reported memory note) is not in the repo
the same commit closed a latent hole found in review (malformed auth bodies escaped as AttributeError past every handler, so NO DM would be sent); its firing is not evidenced
Route R (cron.log, box journals) can bound onset, DM time and the next successful fetch
